title: unload() frees the model: Chrome process-tree RSS before and after, with and without the R17 memory options (Sprint 6)

commit.note: No commit hash was recorded. The runs were made on the Sprint 6 working tree on top of 4f5b011; that tree was committed on 2026-11-19 (0c002f4 to 7d3777b).

machine.label: Apple M5 Pro 48 GB
machine.browser: Google Chrome 157 (installed, Playwright channel "chrome"); the exact build is not recorded in this file

method: The D1-04 (f) test in test/browser/model.spec.ts loads SmolLM2-135M (q4) on WebAssembly through the worker host, generates 8 tokens, reads the process-tree RSS (ps every 250 ms, test/browser/rss.ts; 7 processes), calls unload(), waits 3 s and reads it again. peak is the load model.memory (WebAssembly.Memory) figure. The runs: with-options-run1 is the working tree with the R17 options (the figures docs/memory-options.md quotes); without-options-run1 and run2 are a copy of HEAD (4f5b011) without them; final-run is a later run the same day (13:43 UTC) of the final working tree.
commands: RUNTIME_MODEL=1 RUNTIME_MODEL_LEGS=wasm RUNTIME_MODEL_OUT=<dir> npx playwright test -c test/browser/playwright.model.config.ts model.spec.ts -g "D1-04 (f)"
